title: Goofy Ahh SpongeBob
blurb: Two comedy universes colliding, and neither survives intact. SpongeBob was already the most unhinged thing on children's television; running it through the goofy ahh filter — pitch bent, over-compressed, edges blown out — produces something that should not exist and absolutely does. It is what happens when brainrot editing gets hold of source material that was chaotic to begin with. Play it when regular SpongeBob audio feels somehow too dignified for the moment, a situation that arises more often than you would expect once you start looking for it.
